requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BSPS requires at least 120 credits: 18 general education, 49 science/math/lab, 27 BSPS core, and about 26 electives. A minimum 2.0 cumulative GPA and 60 credits taken at Michigan while in the BSPS are also required and are not auto-checked.

requirements.label: First-year writing (4 credits)
requirements.hint: One course fulfilling the First-Year Writing Requirement.

requirements.label: Humanities or language (7 credits)
requirements.hint: Two courses (4 + 3 credits) in the humanities or a foreign language. Only one AP/IB humanities course may count.

requirements.label: Social science (7 credits)
requirements.hint: Two social science courses (4 + 3 credits). Only one AP/IB social science course may count.

requirements.label: Introductory biology (BIOLOGY 171, 172 & 173)
requirements.hint: The introductory biology lecture pair and lab.

requirements.label: General chemistry (CHEM 130, 125 & 126)
requirements.hint: General chemistry lecture and the two 1-credit labs. BSPS core prerequisites require a C- or better.

requirements.label: Organic chemistry I (CHEM 210 & 211)
requirements.hint: Organic lecture I and its lab.

requirements.label: Organic chemistry II (CHEM 215 & 216)
requirements.hint: Organic lecture II and its lab.

requirements.label: CHEM 230 or 260
requirements.hint: Physical chemistry principles or quantum chemistry.

requirements.label: Biochemistry (BIOLCHEM 415, MCDB 310, or CHEM 351)
requirements.hint: One 4-credit biochemistry course.

requirements.label: Physics lecture (PHYSICS 140 or 150)
requirements.hint: Introductory mechanics.

requirements.label: Physics lab (PHYSICS 141 or 151)
requirements.hint: The matching 1-credit lab.

requirements.label: Calculus I (MATH 115)
requirements.hint: MATH 115 or equivalent AP credit.

requirements.label: Statistics (STATS 250)
requirements.hint: Introduction to statistics and data analysis.

requirements.label: Physiology (PHYSIOL 201 or 502)
requirements.hint: Human physiology.

requirements.label: First-year core (PHARMACY 102 & PHARMSCI 101)
requirements.hint: Exploring Careers in Pharmaceutical Sciences (fall) and the winter introduction to pharmaceutical sciences. BSPS core courses require a C- or better.

requirements.label: Sophomore core (PHARMACY 200, 212, 217 & MEDCHEM 210)
requirements.hint: Science of Medicines, Contemporary Research, Introduction to Precision Health, and Introduction to Medicinal Chemistry.

requirements.label: Junior core (PHARMSCI 300, PHARMACY 302, 312 & MEDCHEM 310)
requirements.hint: Pharmaceutical sciences, Developing Your Professional Self, Clinical and Research Ethics, and Principles of Drug Action.

requirements.label: Senior core (PHARMSCI 400 & MEDCHEM 410)
requirements.hint: Senior-year pharmaceutical sciences (fall) and Concepts in Drug Discovery and Development (winter).

requirements.label: PHARMSCI 402: Undergraduate Seminar (2 terms)
requirements.hint: A 1-credit seminar taken twice, senior fall and winter. Each completed term counts; a planned term registers once, so log each term as taken when it finishes.
